The scientist {npc:Spectulus}, of the Edron Academy, lost his intern {npc:Jack} in an experiment with a time machine. You help convince Jack of who he "really" is: you decorate his house with old furniture, talk to his family and destroy his sculpture. At the end you receive 6000 experience, a {item:Piece of Marble Rock} and one of two achievements, depending on whether you tell Jack the truth or lie to him.
Achievement **Truth Be Told** (if you tell Jack the truth) **or** **You Don't Know Jack** (if you lie to him)
There are no monsters in this quest: you just talk to NPCs and walk around Edron.
Buy the **used** furniture (*Used ...*) from {npc:Edvard}: the normal furniture kits will not do.
Choose carefully at the end: you can only earn **one** of the two achievements.

After completing the {wiki:Sea of Light Quest|Sea of Light Quest}, talk to {npc:Spectulus} at the Edron Academy. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He tells you the story of the trainee Jack, who disappeared into the time machine. Listen to everything and answer {key:yes} two more times.

If you are not in Edron, take a boat and say to the captain {key:hi}, {key:edron}, {key:yes}; you arrive at the port, next to {npc:Captain Seahorse}. Spectulus is on the **top floor** of the Edron Academy ({coord:33268,31832,1}): go up the academy stairs all the way up.

Go to **Jack's house**, marked on your map. Talk to {npc:Jack}: {key:hi}, {key:Spectulus}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He thinks you are crazy and sends you away. The house is a little **north** of the city of Edron: go there and back on foot the same way.

Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:mission}, {key:yes} and {key:yes}. He asks you to change the atmosphere of Jack's house with the furniture he used to have: a red cushioned chair, a globe, a small telescope, a huge amphora and a rocking horse.
Go to {npc:Edvard}'s furniture shop in Edron and buy the 5 **used** kits (290 gp in total). Edvard sells these unique items for this quest.
The normal furniture kits will not do: they have to be the *used* ones.
Set up the furniture in Jack's house
In Jack's house, use each kit anywhere on **this floor**, as if it were your own house. For each piece a message appears and Jack complains:
After the 5 messages, talk to {npc:Jack}: {key:hi}, {key:furniture} and {key:Spectulus}. He insists he has always lived there with his mother and sister.
Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He asks you to tell the truth to Jack's mother and sister.
In Jack's house, go up **1 floor** and talk to {npc:Mother Of Jack}. Answer exactly: {key:hi}, {key:jack}, {key:yes}, {key:no}, {key:yes}.
Go up another **1 floor** and talk to {npc:Sister Of Jack}. Answer: {key:hi}, {key:jack}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}, {key:Spectulus}, {key:yes}.
Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants you to ask Jack about his hobbies and convince him that they do not match the real Jack.
Talk to {npc:Jack}: {key:hi} and {key:hobbies}. He tells you he carves statues and shows you his masterpiece in the corner of the room.
Use the {item:Pick} on the {item:Lizard Statue} behind Jack to destroy it.
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Jack}. He gives up and accepts that he was a trainee at the academy; he wants to see Spectulus.

Go back to {npc:Spectulus} and say {key:mission}. You receive **6000 experience**. He confesses that the real Jack travelled to the **past** (and not to another dimension) and left a letter to be opened 20 years ago, which Spectulus never received because he was not at the academy. In other words, this Jack was someone else, and he asks you to forget the matter.
For the achievement **You Don't Know Jack**, talk to {npc:Jack} and answer {key:hi}, {key:no}, {key:yes} (or {key:hi}, {key:yes}, {key:yes}). That is, you confirm that you told him the truth.
For the achievement **Truth Be Told**, talk to {npc:Jack} and answer {key:hi}, {key:no}, {key:no} (or {key:hi}, {key:yes}, {key:no}). That is, you admit that it was not true.
You can only choose once: you earn only one of the two achievements.
After this quest you can ask {npc:Spectulus} for more missions and tasks.
This quest is part of the {wiki:Tibia Tales|Tibia Tales} log.
